6.312 rsVariableInDataRowSortExpression
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsVariableInDataRowSortExpression is a critical error that will occur if an expression within
GaugePanel.SortExpressions, Chart.SortExpressions, or Tablix.SortExpressions references a Variable
via the Variables global collection.
